entry.title: MEMLNauts Gig
entry.content:
October 3rd 2025. 7pm-11pm The Rose Hill, Brighton, BN1 4JL £5 / £3

Tickets: www.ticketsource.co.uk/memlnauts

Emute Lab presents improvised performances from participants in the Musically Embodied Machine Learning project (MEML).

The MEMLNauts are finding new ways to be creative with machine learning, with impish algorithms driving newly customised instruments . Expect fractious brass, wayward woodwind, unruly vocal processing, and indecorous string feedback.

Embedded machine learning empowers musicians to find new performance approaches, by sharing control with often unpredictable and lively algorithms within the instrument. We will present performances with a variety of machine learning augmented instruments, in solo and group improvisations.

Line up:

Tom Manoury

Bunty

Betty Accorsi

Andrea Martelloni

Luuma

entry.title: Research Visit to the Intelligent Instruments Lab in Reykjavik

link.title: Research Visit to the Intelligent Instruments Lab in Reykjavik

entry.content: Chris and Andrea recent spent a week in Iceland, visiting Thor Magnusson’s Intelligent Instruments Lab at the University of Reykjavik. Following our participatory design method, we spent the week working with Tom Manoury, exploring the augmentation of a euphonium using our MEMLNaut technology. We also working with Stefanos Vasilakis, who used the PAF synthesis MEMLNaut patch with external synth hardware. The week culminated in performances at Mengi, with the addition a duet with Andrea and Betty Accorsi on sax, and a Brain Dead Ensemble style trio with Thor Magnusson playing the Threnoscope, Chris playing MEMLNaut/Xiasri and Betty playing sax.
